environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. git ops must use `git -C c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\google-login-both`. Relative paths resolve against the parent workspace, NOT the worktree — always use absolute paths under the worktree. Do NOT run prisma migrate/db push (plain_password is a raw runtime column kept out of the Prisma model). google-auth-library needs outbound HTTPS to fetch Google certs at verify time.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT break existing login/register/forgot-password, tracking, rider, payments. Reuse the existing issueTokens() + isMobileClient() in api-node/src/routes/users.ts so social login returns the identical { user, token, refreshToken? } shape as /login. Keep bilingual (Hindi/English) copy and existing button styling for the Google button. Client IDs are not secrets but must be read from env first with documented defaults.
key_patterns: API response envelope via ok()/fail() from src/utils/http.ts. issueTokens(res, user, deviceLabel?) sets access+refresh cookies and returns { accessToken, refreshToken, claims }; it needs a user with {id, role, mobile, username, name, permissions, backend_rider}. isMobileClient(req) checks header X-Client:mobile. Prisma User has nullable email AND recovery_email; mobile+username are UNIQUE NOT NULL; register writes recovery_email (+recovery_email_verified). Web shared axios: src/lib/api.ts `api` (base VITE_API_BASE||'/api', withCredentials) + setAccessToken; auth store src/store/auth.ts login() does setAccessToken(data.token)+set({user}). Mobile src/api.ts api.post sends X-Client:mobile; auth store src/store/auth.ts login() does setAccessToken + saveRefreshToken(data.refreshToken) + set user + returns normalized user; login screen done(user) runs registerForPush()+routes. Mobile reads config via Constants.expoConfig.extra in src/config.ts. App scheme 'fourastore' already set (needed by expo-auth-session).
